_meta.purpose: Upcoming shows for the Bolo Boys website. Only upcoming shows are listed here — past shows are covered by social media.
_meta.schema_notes: Each event follows the structure below. Claude populates this via the event_workflow defined in project-context.json.
_meta.invariant: Everything in `events` is announceable. Unconfirmed dates live in the private pipeline and are promoted by MOVING them here. Reasoning: bolo-private/PROPAGATION.md.

_schema_example.theme: Internal fun theme name (e.g. 'The Spring Kickoff')
_schema_example.invitation_text: Warm, playful, community-focused paragraph for expanded card view
_schema_example.additional_details: Any extra info (cover, age restriction, etc.)

events.invitation_text: Another afternoon with our friends at Wild Heaven Avondale — Dirty Shame, Acoustic Station, Ante Up and Bolo Boys sharing the bill for three and a half hours of music. We'll be inside or outside depending on how September's treating us, but the good music, good food and good beer are a sure thing. Free and all-ages, like every show we play here.
events.additional_details: Free and all-ages. Indoor or outdoor depending on weather. Kitchen by Al's Pine Street Market.

events.invitation_text: We're headed north for the Jasper ArtWalk — our first time playing the mountains, on the courthouse square in the middle of downtown. Art, makers, and music up and down the street all afternoon, and we've got the 2 o'clock slot. Come spend a Saturday in the foothills with us.
events.additional_details: Outdoor show on the courthouse square — weather-dependent. Free, all ages. Part of the Jasper ArtWalk; music continues on the square after our set.

logistics_notes.text: BAND BRINGS ITS OWN FULL PA — the square has no house system.
Wrap ~4:40 so the 5-8 PM band can set up. Another performer plays filler between acts.
Lineup: all four, incl. Jamey on drums.

open_questions.text: CLOSED 2026-08-11 on Paul's call — the 9/26 date stands and no email to the ArtWalk organizer is needed. The press leg had surfaced two Pickens outlets summarising the 2026 ArtWalk dates as May 30 / Sept 12; Paul ruled there is nothing to chase. Resting on his own knowledge of the 7/23 confirmation, NOT on a verified source — the smokesignalsnews fetch returned 429 and the articles' publication YEAR was never read (they most likely describe 2025). Kept as a note rather than deleted so the difference is not rediscovered as news; the blocked URL stays on press-legs.json in case it ever matters.

events.invitation_text: An evening on Krog Street with the South River Watershed Alliance — their Wild Fling benefit for a river that does a lot of quiet work for this city. We're the entertainment: two hours, good people, and a room full of folks who actually show up for the water. It's a ticketed benefit — from $30, with general admission, group and student options — and tickets are through South River, linked below.
events.additional_details: Ticketed benefit — from $30, with general admission, group-of-four and student/youth options at southriverga.org. Hosted at the Patagonia store on Krog Street. Doors and program run 7:30–9:30 PM.

external_links.title: Wild Fling '26 — tickets and event details

tickets.note: Ticketed South River Watershed Alliance benefit, from $30 (GA / group-of-four / student-youth). `type` is EMPTY on purpose: Bandsintown's accepted values for the Ticket Type column are not documented in anything this repo holds, and a wrong enum fails the row. Confirm on the BIT upload form, then set it. What matters most is the URL — without it, ticket-buyers were being sent to our own homepage.

logistics_notes.text: Load in through the elevator at the BACK of the store, on Krog St — pull up, unload, venue staff help wheel it up. (venue, 2026-08-19)
Band brings PA and all needed equipment — the host is not providing sound. (host, 2026-08-19)
Billed to the host as a FOUR-PIECE. (host, 2026-08-19)
Walk-through before show day so Paul can see the space; Paul owes the host a heads-up on timing (confirmed 2026-08-26).

open_questions: Placement not settled: in front of the slideshow screen (lounge furniture moved, partial screen block is fine) OR front of store + breezeway/porch. The walk-through decides.
PA/stage detail follows from placement — power, where the PA lands.
Pay: never discussed. Still TBD with the host.

events.invitation_text: The first of our Friday nights at Wild Heaven Avondale — Dirty Shame, Acoustic Station, Ante Up and Bolo Boys taking turns through three 45-minute sets from 6:30 on. A full taproom, Al's kitchen going, and the kind of October evening that makes you glad the patio's still open. Free and all-ages, like every show we play here. Come hungry, come early.
events.additional_details: Three 45-minute sets from 6:30 PM. Indoor or outdoor depending on weather.
